subject: [PATCH v3 1/3] mm: swap: move LRU insertion out of the swap cache allocator

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch moves the insertion of a folio into the LRU (Least Recently Used) list out of the swap cache allocator function. The reason for this change is that zswap writeback requires a swap cache folio that can be freed directly once writeback completes, without being on the LRU. The patch introduces a new function __swap_cache_alloc_folio() that allocates a folio but does not add it to the LRU, allowing the caller to manage its lifecycle. This change is intended to be functional equivalent to the original code and only affects how the LRU is handled.
